title: Frontend product manifest -> generated products.tsx -> scenes/urls consumers
answers: How does products/<name>/manifest.tsx get into the app?
Can I edit frontend/src/products.tsx by hand?
body:
- Contract: `frontend/src/types.ts:ProductManifest` (name, scenes, routes[path]=[SceneName, sceneKey], redirects, urls, fileSystemTypes, treeItemsNew/Products/Games/Metadata, setupProbe). `SceneConfig` is in `frontend/src/scenes/sceneTypes.ts`.
- Generator: `frontend/build-products.mjs` scans `products/*/manifest.tsx` via TS AST (no import), skips if input hash unchanged (`.cache/products.hash`).
- Outputs: `frontend/src/products.tsx` (GENERATED, DO NOT EDIT: productRoutes, productRedirects, productConfiguration (import stripped), productUrls, fileSystemTypes, productSetupProbes, getTreeItems*), `frontend/src/productScenes.tsx` (productScenes: name -> lazy import; separate so jest doesn't treat every test as related to a scene change), `frontend/src/products.json` (tree item metadata, read by Python `posthog/products.py:Products`).
- Consumers: `frontend/src/scenes/urls.ts` spreads `...productUrls`; `frontend/src/scenes/scenes.ts` spreads productConfiguration/productRedirects/productRoutes; `frontend/src/scenes/appScenes.ts` spreads `...productScenes`.
- Generator does not copy imports: new icon/type used in a manifest must be imported in products.tsx by hand (products/README.md 'Manual setup').
